$comment: Single source for harness limits and thresholds. WORKFLOW.md §2, §5.2 and §6 cite this file. Read by generator/scripts/awarelib.py.
$comment_model: Decision 0017 Q4: the fallback is manual only (no --fallback-model flag), so one run never mixes models; a fallback run passes --model <generate_model_fallback> and is recorded in the manifest and the run log.
$comment_self_repair: Decision 0017 Q3: at most self_repair_max attempts per checkpoint and self_repair_total_max per /generate run; enforced by generator/scripts/checkpoint.py.

count_lines.$comment: Excluded from changed_lines (WORKFLOW §6.2). Binary files (numstat '-') are always excluded.

headers.$comment: check_headers.py: GENERATED header marker and which files must carry it.
headers.header_text: GENERATED by the Aware harness from spec {spec_version} — do not edit; change the spec and regenerate.

trace.$comment: check_trace.py (E-PM-1, E-PM-3 gate; E-QA-1 coverage is informational unless --strict-coverage). A rule is a bold spec id matching spec_id_regex that opens a list item or table row containing must_keyword. file_apps (by file name) and default_apps say which apps must cover a rule; an [apps: a, b] marker on the definition line overrides.

regen.$comment: regen_check.py (E-PIPE-1). {app} and {model} are substituted. per_feature=false (default, OM-0011): the per-app stage after S6 `met` goes straight to done and regen_check.py runs once at P7 (--app all); true: S6b runs per delivery as before.

commits.$comment: lint_commits.py (E-PIPE-3), trailers per WORKFLOW §8. Feature is required at feature stages (feature_stage_regex) and optional at gates; when present it is a feature id (F1.., or the core delivery D1) or a phase id (P0..P8).

generate.$comment: Values render_prompt.py --generate fills into generator/prompts/generate.md. {app} is substituted.
generate.claude_flags: --max-turns 400 --max-budget-usd 75 --output-format json --effort high --permission-mode acceptEdits --permission-prompts none --allowedTools "Read" "Write" "Edit" "Glob" "Grep" "Bash(./gradlew *)" "Bash(npm *)" "Bash(npx *)" "Bash(python3 generator/scripts/*)" "Bash(git status *)" "Bash(git rev-parse *)" "Bash(rm -rf clients/*)" "Bash(mkdir *)" "Bash(ls *)" "Bash(cd *)"
generate.$comment_claude_flags: Design §3.1, §3.6; decision 0017 Q5, Q6. Limits 400 turns / 75 USD per app run, recalibrated after the first real run. Flags exist in the Claude Code CLI reference (checked 2026-10-14); --permission-prompts needs v2.1.259+. TBD-verify-on-operator-machine: --effort high for this model, allowlist matching of the commands the run needs. --allowedTools stays last because it takes a list.
env_patterns: Could not create the Java Virtual Machine
generate.$comment_patterns: build_digest.py: env_patterns are literal substrings, pin_patterns are regular expressions. A log with compiler errors or failing tests is CODE whatever else it contains; otherwise ENV, then PIN, then CODE (design §3.2).

prompt_lint.$comment: lint_prompts.py (E-EVOL-1): feature nouns must not appear in generator prompts outside fenced blocks whose info string contains example_fence_word.
